## What Phase 13 adds
Phase 13 evaluates the whole production rather than one subsystem at a time. It combines technical integrity, automated creative preflight, shared character-motion inheritance, and mandatory human creative review. Automated hard rejects cover story/representation regressions, character/object mechanics, continuity, structural intelligence, annotation, audio, camera, composition, provenance and final synthesis.

The human gate requires a mean score of **9.0+**, no category below **8.0**, and critical categories — story clarity, illustration quality, character performance, continuity/transformation and board composition — at **9.0+** with no human hard rejects.

## Stick-character inheritance now binding
Before this phase was locked, Whiteboard was connected to the shared `NEX_STICKMAN_V1` foundation. `stick-woman` and other stick-style identities are visual skins only; the same canonical anatomy, captured/authored motion, locomotion, attention, independent hands, contact correction and ownership timing are inherited. Phase 13 hard-rejects any divergence.

## Negative regression
The previously rejected Golden Slice 01 is still rejected by the new QA engine. The engine catches box/arrow dominance, generic-diagram regression, text-dependent storytelling, hero-stickman substitution, repetitive visual grammar and incoherent final-board composition in the negative fixture. It is **not** being revived or polished.

## Certification boundary
The compliant fixture used in the test suite is synthetic. Its PASS only proves that the QA engine can admit a compliant record; it is not a creative film and does not certify Whiteboard. A real production must still pass Phase 13 automatically **and** receive the mandatory human scores.

## Next
**Phase 14 — Golden Slice 01 v2**: the first real 25–40 second production using the full Phase 0–13 stack, including the shared Stickman motion foundation for any stick-style character.
